justice: Most visible space is allocated to motor-vehicle carriageway, with two broad asphalt lanes and center markings, while no clear sidewalk or pedestrian zone is visible on either side.
White guardrails line both sides of the bridge-like segment, but they function mainly as edge barriers; there is no visible curb ramp, tactile paving, or marked pedestrian access for inclusive use.

For all road users, the distribution of space appears uneven because drivers have continuous dedicated pavement, while pedestrians and other slower users do not have clearly designated facilities in the image.
